title: bnwb modpack
description: this is a vanilla plus modpack with terrain gen mods lots of new structures and new gear and items
body: This modpack enhances vanilla with new structures and terrain, offering amazing modded gameplay. Unlike similar modspacks, it includes a wide range of quality of life mods, improving gameplay/aesthetic/. Users will love the peformance mods, making it a must-have for people with slow computers. Download for if you want to play a big modpack with little to no lag, ensuring a smoother, more immersive experience.
